format: Mono signed 16-bit PCM, 22050 Hz. Original downloaded Ogg decoded once with ffmpeg; canonical PCM masters committed for dependency-free rebuilds. Normalized to peak 0.75; maximum duration 3 seconds.

cues.treatment: Trim to 0.65 seconds; 8 ms fade-in and 250 ms fade-out from 0.40 seconds, before PCM normalization.

30 Hz DC blocker; trim decoded frames 325..29921 (end exclusive, -48 dB peak threshold, 8 ms margin); 6 ms cosine fades; weighted DC removal; peak 0.75; zero-sum PCM rounding. Before normalization, 3 ms Gaussian RMS-envelope expansion (gain = 0.18 + 0.82 * normalized_envelope^5.216456) targets -18.5 dBFS RMS, preserving consonants with a gain floor; original speed and pitch.
